# ADR-3101: A09: Immutable log sink required key for archive 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Mutable sinks allow attackers to erase trails.

## Decision

Security logging MUST declare an immutable log sink required key for archive 5 (A09-5).

## Consequences

Sinks enforce append-only controls.
